look: XORA site look at its most cinematic: deep void ground, glass panels with cyan-to-violet edges, light that sweeps and blooms, volumetric scan rings, streaming data, depth and parallax. Website promo telling the true story of XORA's first user Tisan: his first live Binance day (168 trades, +36.43 USDT after fees from a 14 USDT start). Short cut, about 45 s, confident wording.

scenes.name: The question
scenes.desc: On the void: do you know what happened to our first user, Tisan?

scenes.name: 14 USDT
scenes.desc: His whole starting balance counts up: 14 USDT, about 1,400 rupees.

scenes.name: The engine
scenes.desc: The XORA engine wakes: a sphere of market data spins, rings scan, numbers stream; scanning, analysing, calculating.

scenes.name: AI filter
scenes.desc: Setups pour into the Advanced AI filter; ring after ring removes the risky ones; a few clean trades pass.

scenes.name: The climb
scenes.desc: The live account line climbs to the day's +36.43 USDT.

scenes.name: Best 3 trades
scenes.desc: Three trade cards on real candles: DOOD sell +44.73, ALT sell +12.08, IOST sell +7.30.

scenes.name: The result
scenes.desc: Totals land: 168 trades executed, +36.43 USDT after fees, 14 to 50.43 USDT.

scenes.name: Your story
scenes.desc: Your story could be next. xora.xtinex.com, the brain tutor, a short risk note.
